notes.title: Steam Deck VERIFIED
notes.content:
That's right, DUSK '82 and the Steam Workshop filled with nearly 500 custom maps are now ✔️Steam Deck Verified.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268758/a519ea45a6a66c1581c65d8cb11d1f648e4d4fed.png

You can now play DUSK '82 on a train, on a plane, in a car, on the toilet, during a zoom call with your boss, at your family reunion with your in laws, while waiting for your pizza to show up, while waiting for your dad to come home from the store where he said he was going to get smokes 20 years ago T_T

To celebrate this MOMENTOUS achievement, the game is also 20% OFF all week long!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465510/DUSK_82_ULTIMATE_EDITION/

Tell a friend, tell an enemy, tell your dad when he gets back!

Want more DUSK? Get the IRON DUSK bundle for DUSK, DUSK '82 and IRON LUNG. A game which has nothing to do with DUSK but we bundled it with DUSK to capitalize on the popularity of David's latest indie horror hit. CONSUME.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25842/IRON_DUSK/

notes.title: DUSK '82: ULTIMATE EDITION OUT NOW
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=xoYsa7AAyTQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, the biggest release of the year has landed on Steam...

DUSK '82: ULTIMATE EDITION
FEATURING

 A 30 level campaign that serves as a prequel to DUSK
 Included chiptune DUSK soundtrack by Andrew Hulshult
 Built in Level Editor + Steam Workshop Support
 Full controller support in game and editor
 Achievements, badges and trading cards (If Valve approves them)
 Two bonus ASCII games for free (seriously)
 RTX, DLSS and FSR support (not seriously)

We've even already put some goodies on the workshop for you! 
Such as an "EGA" version with sprites by Fallen Aces artist Trey Powell.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268758/a931acfbe927026bdcf53e5129185af8cff8f7b6.jpg

And of course a "spooky" DUSK-O-Ween map + sprite pack to celebrate the season.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40268758/e13e0f05bd79b0730de43345023b91bb11095e60.jpg

All joking aside, what started as a fun little side project for David that we used as an April Fool's joke, has turned into a fully featured game that you can't help but love. We can't wait for you to play it and can't wait to see what kind of ridiculous things you make with the level editor. ːbigjohnː GLHF.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465510/Dusk_82/
